action: Wide: garden after rain. Milo splashes into a puddle and looks up at the sky.
sound: Music: soft intro bed (low). SFX: puddle splash, birds.

action: Pip hops beside Milo, looks up, ears droop.
line: Pip: "But wait. A stripe is missing!"

action: Close-up of the rainbow gap; a tiny sparkle fizzles out where blue should be.
line: Milo: "Oh no! Where did it go?"
sound: SFX: sad descending 'bwoop'. Music: drops out.

action: Title card: 'Milo and the Missing Rainbow Color' over the S01 garden plate.
sound: Music: theme sting, 6 s. SFX: sparkle on title reveal.

action: Milo waves at camera.
Pip waves at camera, scarf flutters.
Both look up at the rainbow; Narrator explains.
line: Narrator: "Milo and Pip love rainbows. But this one is not finished."

action: Pip counts stripes, tapping the air with her paw.
sound: SFX: soft 'ting' on each color word (5).

action: Milo flaps his wings with determination.
line: Milo: "Something is gone. Let's find it!"
sound: SFX: wing flaps. Music: lifts to 'adventure' theme.

action: Silent beat: Pip spots something white in the grass and gasps.
Both hop to the card. Milo picks it up.
line: Milo: "A clue! There is a picture on it."
sound: SFX: two soft hops, paper rustle.

action: Insert: card shows a drawing of red tulips.
Travel: both hop along a garden path. No dialogue.
sound: Music: bouncy travel theme. SFX: hops on wet grass.

action: Arrive at the tulip bed; both gasp happily.
line: Narrator: "Milo and Pip find a bed of beautiful flowers."

action: Q1: Milo turns to camera and asks. HOLD 4 s for viewers.
line: Milo: "What color are these flowers?" [PAUSE 4 s]
sound: Music: soft tick-tock bed under the pause.

action: Pip cheers the answer.
Silent: Milo sniffs a tulip and sneezes; petals wiggle.
sound: SFX: sniff, tiny 'achoo!', petal rustle. Music: playful sting.

action: Pip finds the second card tucked between tulips.
Insert: card shows a drawing of a pond with lily pads.
Travel: the friends hop toward the pond. No dialogue.
Pond establishing; a lily pad bobs.
line: Narrator: "Here is the pond. The water is calm and shiny."
sound: SFX: soft water lap, frog-free nature ambience.

action: Q2: Pip asks the viewers. HOLD 4 s.
line: Pip: "What color are the lily pads?" [PAUSE 4 s]
sound: Music: soft tick-tock bed under the pause.

action: Milo answers proudly.
Silent: Milo steps onto a lily pad; it wobbles; he flaps to balance.
sound: SFX: wobble 'boing-oing', flaps, tiny splash. Music: comic pizzicato.

action: Milo spots a card floating on the next lily pad.
Insert: card shows a drawing of tall yellow sunflowers.
Milo hops back to the bank and they head off.
sound: SFX: hop, splash. Music: travel theme starts.

action: Travel: hop along the fence to the sunflowers. No dialogue.
sound: Music: travel theme, a little faster.

action: Sunflowers tower over the friends; they look up.
Silent: Pip stands on tiptoe; Milo climbs onto Pip's shoulders to reach a card in the leaves.
sound: SFX: effort 'hup!', giggles. Music: playful build.

action: Milo grabs the card; both tumble softly into the grass, laughing.
Insert: card shows a drawing of a pinwheel.
Pip points down the fence; the pinwheel is far away, glinting.
line: Pip: "I see one! At the end of the fence!"
sound: SFX: distant twinkle. Music: anticipation build.

action: Travel: both hurry along the fence. No dialogue.
Pinwheel reveal: still, glowing faintly.
line: Narrator: "There it is. A little pinwheel, all alone."
sound: Music: soft, magical. SFX: gentle hum.

action: Q3: Milo asks the viewers. HOLD 4 s.
line: Milo: "What color is the pinwheel?" [PAUSE 4 s]
sound: Music: soft tick-tock bed under the pause.

action: Both cheer; Pip connects the idea.
line: Pip: "Blue! The missing color is blue!"
sound: SFX: big cheer chime. Music: rising.

action: Milo blows on the pinwheel; it barely turns.
sound: SFX: small 'phoo' blow, a weak click.

action: Pip smiles and stands beside him.
line: Pip: "Let's blow together. One, two, three!"

action: Silent: both blow; the pinwheel spins fast and glows bright blue.
sound: SFX: big 'whoosh', fast whirring, magical chime swell.

action: A ribbon of blue light streams up from the pinwheel into the sky. No dialogue. MULTI-CLIP BEAT (A+B).
sound: Music: magical swell. SFX: shimmering trail.

action: The ribbon slides into the gap; the rainbow is complete and shines.
sound: SFX: soft 'click' and sparkle burst. Music: theme in full.

action: Both jump and cheer under the full rainbow.
line: Milo: "We did it!" Pip: "The rainbow is whole again!"

action: Narrator lands the lesson over a gentle hug.
line: Narrator: "When friends work together, big things can happen."

action: Recap intro: both face camera.
line: Pip: "Let's remember the colors we found today."

action: Recap: red tulips.
Recap: green lily pads.
Recap: yellow sunflowers.
Recap: blue pinwheel.
Both wave goodbye to camera.
line: Milo: "Thank you for helping us!" Pip: "Bye-bye, friends!"

action: Silent: the friends hop away down the path under the rainbow. MULTI-CLIP BEAT (A+B).
End screen: rainbow sky background with two video-card slots and a subscribe area.
sound: Music: theme outro, fade out over the last 3 s.
